rubric.role_summary: Correspondent banking compliance role focused on onboarding international bank partners, assessing country and political risk, designing diligence and monitoring processes, and conducting partner reviews.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Correspondent banking compliance role focused on onboarding international bank partners, assessing country and political risk, designing diligence and monitoring processes, and conducting partner reviews.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 6+ years of regulatory, compliance, or risk management experience focused on international financial activity.
- Ability to build and operationalize policies, procedures, and workflows.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Previous correspondent banking experience.
- Strong familiarity with underwriting geographic and political risks.
- Project management experience coordinating efforts across multiple teams.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California; USA. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
